purpose: Resolve effects below the detection threshold of the 72-document splits (+-15 %). Pre-registered before any of these runs.
split: big: 600 new documents x 1024 tokens, 100 per domain, sources disjoint from cal/select/confirm/long (data/big_manifest.json)
primary_metric: mean KL(teacher||student) over the 600 documents; paired difference vs control with bootstrap over documents
control: A0_Q0ldlq_big (re-run of A0_Q0ldlq: same code, same multiplier)

candidates.ArotN_Q0ldlq_big: re-run of ArotN_Q0ldlq (native rotated residual basis, seed 0, match_bpw 2.8158)
candidates.A0_Qperm_ldlq: columns processed by decreasing input second moment (stored permutation), per-matrix rate matching

note: Each variant is created by a full sequential E8-LDLQ pass and evaluated once. No further selection is made on this split.
